title: DataCupid: Stable Matching Repair for Training Data Acquisition with Delayed Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.12960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Matching repair after utility changes can reuse valid observations, but new evaluations must respect matching capacity and may return out of order. We study announced invalidations with bounded, possibly reward-dependent reporting delays and pending evaluations that do not occupy future matching capacity. Residualload repair (RLR) combines sound outcome certificates with batched matching schedules for unequal sample deficits. Its complete dyadic quota schedule admits a sharp issue-round bound with coefficient cb < 1.607 relative to the terminal residual endpoint load, together with separate delay and evidence-lifetime bounds. RLR-P monitors complete issue-order prefixes without changing the sampling plan before acceptance. With a deterministic pure oracle, a single-repair coupling from the same drained initial state guarantees no increase in certification time, issued observations, or time to a reusable checkpoint. translated_title: DataCupid：面向具有延迟反馈的训练数据获取的稳定匹配修复
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12960v1 公告类型： new 摘要：效用变化后的匹配修复可以复用有效的观测结果，但新的评估必须遵守匹配容量限制，且可能乱序返回结果。我们研究具有有界的（可能依赖于奖励的）报告延迟的已宣布失效问题，以及不占用未来匹配容量的待处理评估。剩余负载修复（RLR）将可靠的结果证书与针对不均等样本缺口的批量匹配调度相结合。其完整的二元配额调度实现了相对于终端剩余端点负载、系数 cb < 1.607 的尖锐发布轮次界限，并具有独立的延迟界限和证据生命周期界限。RLR-P 监控完整的发布顺序前缀，在接受之前不改变采样计划。在确定性纯预言机下，来自相同耗尽初始状态的单次修复耦合保证认证时间、发布的观测数量或达到可复用检查点的时间均不会增加。我们还推导出一个信息……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出剩余负载修复（RLR）方法，通过将可靠的结果证书与批量匹配调度相结合，解决训练数据获取中带延迟反馈的稳定匹配修复问题，并证明其发布轮次界限和单次修复耦合能保证认证时间、观测发布量及检查点时间均不增加。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Residual Load Repair (RLR), which combines sound outcome certificates with batched matching schedules for stable matching repair under delayed feedback in training data acquisition, providing a sharp issue-round bound and a single-repair coupling that guarantees no increase in certification time, issued observations, or time to a reusable checkpoint.
